TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Develop baseline total-body strength with hypertrophy emphasis"

PHASES

    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper/Lower Push-Pull - Week 1":
        warmup: cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 8
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 8
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 8
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 8
        cooldown: shoulder_stretch 60 seconds

        warmup: jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..14 rpe 8
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..12 rpe 8
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 8
          calf_raise 3x12..20 rpe 8
        cooldown: quad_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Thursday training 60m "Push Strength - Week 1":
        warmup: jump_rope 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 8
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 8
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..15 rpe 8
          front_raise 3x12 rpe 8
        cooldown: chest_stretch 60 seconds

        main straight_sets:

          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 8

        cooldown: tricep_stretch 60 seconds

        warmup: walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets: rowing 15m rpe 6
        cooldown: walking 5 minutes

        main interval: bike_sprint 20s x 8
        cooldown: easy_cycle 2 minutes
